info.title: Portal Execution Governance Review API
info.description: Same-origin, session-guarded Portal governance boundaries for R1/R2 review, immutable approval history, R1 request creation, conditions/waivers, Paper Exit and source-dark Sandbox Certification. No endpoint in this slice commands the Trading System.

Returns immutable terminal approval attempts with bounded bidirectional keyset pagination. REQUEST_CHANGES appears as CHANGES_REQUESTED and never rewrites the governed gate.

get.description: Named operation detail. Exact ecm_ intents retain current exact audit authority and finite CommandStatus. SCOPED_V2 uses positive stored family identity: F0 keeps immutable queue/intent provenance and exact target audit; selected R2/Paper plans require BOTH current PAPER deployment/portfolio audit anchors, ROOT plus exact DECISION_OPERATION field purpose and the actual gate/member requirement. Unknown, unsupported or ambiguous identity never tries another family. No creator/ADMIN/read_all permission substitute. Legacy decision readers remain separate. Historical expiry/expected versions do not expire today's authorized read or assert current apply eligibility. GET never dispatches/reconciles; stored Portal APPLIED is not TS acceptance/FILLED. HTTP private, no-store.

get.description: Sticky current Core mode preserves legacy v1 separately. SCOPED_V2 publishes only a finite current-authorized Portal parent after BOTH current TS-qualified deployment/portfolio audit anchors and the exact reviewed root field purpose. Sandbox uses SANDBOX current correspondence and active membership; Canary uses LIVE current correspondence plus independent governance.canary.read. Current association is NOT captured historical native membership. Optional fields require separate purposes. Stored Portal evaluation/DRAFT never asserts a source verdict, current eligibility, activated runtime or effective capital; source screens remain explicitly unpublished. No mutation/upstream call, owner/ADMIN shortcut or fallback after current-authority refusal. One shared flight fences body and contextual errors after local/source checks and LAST Core.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: SCOPED_V2 only; the legacy body ignores it. include=identity attaches the closed `identity` block from a separate fenced retained-projection read under the viewer's own alpha.read row and field policy. Any other value is refused (400 EXECUTION_READ_QUERY_INVALID). Omitted: the body is byte-identical to before. It is not a parent record field and not a parent-field purpose.

StageActionEligibilityRow.description: One stage action. `stage_action` is a display identifier for a button, NOT a capability name and never accepted as authority. verdict ELIGIBLE means the route's own knowable preconditions did not refuse the caller; the row-level checks (run completeness, parent approval, versions, projection freshness, idempotency) still run at submit and every route rechecks current authority. NOT_COMMISSIONED means no Portal route exists for the action, whatever grants the caller holds. basis names the rule the producing route enforces today. step_up_required is false for the three Portal routes that exist today (approval create, sandbox review note, paper-exit request; they demand none) and null (not determined, never false) where no route exists. For sandbox.review_note and paper.exit_review_request the verdict is computed by the SAME predicate as the review-capture-capabilities read (one authority, so the two cannot disagree about one control).

observed_at_ms.description: Portal evaluation time (UTC epoch ms), not a source observation time and not a permission lease. Re-ask on mount, workspace switch and focus; do not cache across sessions.

session_step_up.description: This session's step-up fact (the one the access/capital mutations recheck), scoped to this session only. ACTIVE requires valid_until_ms greater than observed_at_ms; NOT_ACTIVE has null. It changes no verdict above.

StageActionEligibility.description: FE-068. Own advisory per-action eligibility for exactly ten stage actions in a fixed order, before the click. Authorization: session + workspace membership + a fresh database recheck of session and role before and after the reads. Grants nothing and consults no related capability for the commands without a route. Valid_until semantics are deliberately absent: this is a snapshot, not a lease.

ApprovalRequestLookup.description: FE-069. Read-only answer to "what would replaying this request_key do?" for the CALLER'S OWN requests (keyed by requester: another actor's request under the same key is indistinguishable from NONE). NONE: a replay would create. FOUND: result is exactly the governance.approval-create.v1 body a replay returns (replayed=true). KEY_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT: only when all four payload fields were supplied and differ from the stored request; a replay would answer 409 REQUEST_KEY_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT and no approval body. Without payload fields the stored payload is NOT compared (payload_check NOT_COMPARED): FOUND then only says a request exists under this key. Same authority as the replay it mirrors (current session + workspace membership, no gate capability). Writes nothing.
